headline: COO at Altman Solon
summary:
I am a COO and executive operator with 20+ years of experience building and scaling professional services organizations across Europe, the Americas, and APAC.

I work at the intersection of strategy and execution — partnering with leadership teams to transform strategic priorities into scalable structures, governance frameworks, and sustained performance.

Core themes in my work:
• Enterprise transformation & operating model design
• Post-merger integration & cross-border governance
• Building scalable support functions (research, marketing, knowledge)
• KPI-driven performance systems
• Translating strategy into execution discipline

company.name: Altman Solon
company.tagline: The world's largest strategy consulting firm focused exclusively on the Telecoms, Media, and Technology (TMT) sectors
company.description:
In 2020, Altman Vilandrie & Company and Solon Management Consulting cemented a decades-long partnership across the Atlantic to form Altman Solon, the world’s largest global strategy consulting firm with an exclusive focus on the TMT sector.

Our consultants are united by our passion and intellectual curiosity for the Telecommunications, Media, and Technology (TMT) sectors. These sectors, representing a $5+ trillion global market, are defined by remarkable technological innovations, business model disruptions, rapidly shifting consumer demands, shrinking barriers to entry, and confusing regulatory changes – challenges that Altman Solon is prepared for and eager to address on behalf of our clients.

As trusted advisors to major industry players and leading investors, we have helped to identify, develop, and implement many of the era-defining strategies that have shaped the TMT sector over the last twenty years.

We work with market leaders and challenger companies across the TMT ecosystem to identify, develop, and implement company strategies, go-to-market approaches, digital innovation, and global M&A. Our investor clients benefit from deep sector expertise that enables them to conduct due diligence and make investment decisions with confidence.

Our team serves clients globally from our 18 offices spanning the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, and APAC.
